featured_reviews.review_text: I recently underwent a hysterectomy at Shri Namah Healthcare under the treatment of Dr. Munjal Kapadia, and my experience has been excellent. I was able to start walking on the second day after surgery, which really boosted my confidence and recovery. With proper guidance from the doctors on post-operative care, my healing process was fast and comfortable. I was able to resume my job from home within 15 days, manage all household work by 4 weeks, and even start traveling to the office by cab. The doctors and staff were extremely patient, supportive, and always ready to answer my questions. Although the diagnostic services here are on the costlier side, I was able to manage them through my company health insurance; otherwise, it may feel expensive. However, if you choose the general ward or twin sharing package or can afford the higher medical expenses, this hospital is truly one of the best choices. I highly recommend Shri Namah Healthcare with a 5-star rating for its 5-star treatment and services. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had a deeply painful and traumatic experience at Arihant Multispecialist Hospital. My nani had already passed away by the afternoon, but the hospital staff unnecessarily prolonged the situation till late night, finally declaring it around 3 AM. This felt extremely inhuman and unethical.

I would strongly urge people to think carefully before choosing this hospital for their loved ones.

My 14-year-old sister was admitted to Saraswati Hospital, Kandivali West on 14/08/2025. After being administered anesthesia, she became unresponsive - unable to open her eyes or breathe on her own. She was shifted to ICU where she remained for 25 days with no recognition of family members.
In my experience, the doctors and staff were unprofessional and seemed focused on money. My sister’s condition kept deteriorating. She remained in a coma-like state for over a month and sadly passed away on 14/09/2025.

I am sharing this so others are aware of our experience at this hospital.

featured_reviews.name: priya phule
featured_reviews.review_text:
❌ Very Disappointing Experience :

I was admitted to this hospital due to severe stomach pain. Unfortunately, there was a significant delay in starting proper treatment, which caused my condition to become critical. The doctors and staff did not show the urgency and seriousness expected in such situations.

The behavior of the staff was unprofessional. Instead of being supportive, they were rude and spoke harshly, making it seem as if the patient was exaggerating the problem. The focus appeared to be more on billing and money rather than on patient care.

Based on my personal experience, I do not recommend this hospital. It is better to consider other hospitals for proper and timely treatment.

featured_reviews.name: Priyadarshani Rambade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was hospitalized here for severe pain, but unfortunately, my experience was very disappointing. Despite clearly explaining my symptoms and requesting to do test , the hospital staff did not perform one. Later, it was confirmed that I had an intestinal obstruction — something that could have been diagnosed much earlier with proper testing.

This negligence not only caused me unnecessary pain but also wasted a lot of my time and money. I expected much better care and attention. I hope the hospital improves their diagnostic process and patient care in the future.

Worse experience, they don't even have proper billing system, this hospital works only for money!

featured_reviews.name: Ameya . A . Mallya
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when you are truly tested — emotionally, mentally, and spiritually. A few days ago, my father suffered a sudden paralysis attack around 9 PM. With panic in our hearts and confusion in our minds, we rushed him to a local government hospital, where we were told he had suffered the attack due to dangerously high blood sugar and low blood pressure. While they did give initial medication and his condition was somewhat stabilized, there were no ICU beds available, and he was kept in a general ward — despite the seriousness of his condition.

Worse still, the lack of communication between shifts, absence of a neurologist, and most importantly, the inability to conduct a timely MRI Brain scan left us helpless. On the second day, despite his worsening state, no doctor came to check on him properly.

That's when we made the decision to shift him to Saraswati Hospital Charkop — and I can confidently say, it was the best decision we could have made.

From the moment we entered Saraswati Hospital, we felt a shift — not just in care, but in humanity.

✨ As soon as we arrived, my father was immediately admitted to the ICU — a step that should have been taken from the very beginning but wasn’t possible at the previous hospital due to lack of facilities.

Dr. Akash was the first to receive us. He took immediate charge, reviewed previous diagnostics (which were shockingly insufficient), and without delay began stabilizing my father’s blood pressure. In a few hours, he also discovered that a bacterial infection in one of his organs was hindering recovery — something no one else had even bothered to look into. With precise intervention and prompt treatment, he brought his vitals back under control and gave us hope.

But the care didn’t stop there.

🌙 Dr. Sagar, who handled the night shift, ensured every single detail about my father's condition was understood — from meds administered to progress made. With immense presence of mind, he took the call to get the MRI Brain scan done at 1 AM, which turned out to be a game-changer. Because of that timely decision, we had the reports ready, and action could be taken swiftly.

🌅 The following day, Dr. Jigar, senior to both, reviewed everything — the reports, the recovery, the medications — and designed the perfect course of action. What we deeply appreciated throughout was how all the tests to be done, reports generated, and treatment plans were clearly explained and transparently communicated to us by the doctors — making us feel informed, reassured, and involved at every step.

Under their supervision, my father not only improved rapidly but also stood up and walked out on discharge day, balanced and confident.

More than the treatment, what touched us deeply was the respect, warmth, and dignity shown to my father. Every nurse, every helper, every doctor, treated him like their own elder, talking to him kindly, encouraging him constantly, and making him believe that recovery wasn’t just possible — it was certain. Even days later, they continue to greet him with smiles and humor, teasing him with love: “Uncle, get well soon — not too soon though, we’ll miss you!”

🙏 I have no words enough to thank the entire team at Saraswati Hospital Charkop. They not only saved my father's life, but also his spirit. As a son, I am forever grateful. If you're in doubt about where to take your loved one in a critical situation — go to Saraswati Hospital Charkop without hesitation. The professionalism, compassion, presence of mind, and above all, humanity shown here is unmatched.

From the bottom of my heart — Thank you, Saraswati Hospital Charkop. Thank you, Dr. Jigar Bhat, Dr. Akash Yadav, Dr. Sagar, and every soul who helped. You are angels in white coats. 👨‍⚕️
